title: AKS Exam Quiz: Azure DevOps, AKS, Terraform

questions.question: Which Azure DevOps artifact stores pipeline run logs and build artifacts?
questions.explanation: Azure Artifacts is used for package feeds; pipeline artifacts are stored as pipeline artifacts tied to Pipelines. In the context of storing build artifacts, 'Artifacts' is the closest match.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a YAML file in Azure Pipelines?
choices: Define pipeline stages and steps as code
questions.explanation: YAML files define the pipeline as code: stages, jobs, and steps.

questions.question: Name two built-in service connections in Azure DevOps for deploying to Azure.
questions.explanation: Common service connections include 'Azure Resource Manager' (ARM) and container registries; users may supply names of valid service connections.

questions.question: Which orchestration component schedules pods onto nodes in an AKS cluster?
questions.explanation: The kube-scheduler assigns pods to nodes based on resource requirements and constraints.

questions.question: How do you upgrade the Kubernetes version of an AKS cluster?
questions.explanation: Use the Azure CLI command 'az aks upgrade' to upgrade cluster Kubernetes versions.

questions.question: Describe briefly what a Kubernetes 'Deployment' provides compared to a single Pod.
questions.explanation: Deployments provide replica management, rolling updates, and restore-on-failure behavior.

questions.question: What command shows the execution plan that Terraform will perform?
questions.explanation: 'terraform plan' previews changes without applying them.

questions.question: Which of these is a Terraform state backend option?
questions.explanation: Terraform supports multiple backends including local files, S3/Azure Blob, Consul, and remote backends.

questions.question: What is the purpose of 'terraform init'?
questions.answerText: Initializes working directory, downloads providers and modules
questions.explanation: 'terraform init' initializes the directory and fetches required providers and modules.
